row.title: A surface proved alone is not proved
row.body: Found: seed/worker/src/visibility.js answered 404 for /.well-known/ultrastable.json and /api/graph whenever PUBLIC_HEALTH_ONLY=1, which deploy/deploy-seed.mjs sets on every seed and visitor app, and deploy-seed bound no PUBLIC_URL, so manifest() returned url null. Fixed in code with PUBLIC_READS, the footer and the bindings; seed/worker tests pass (546) and tests/foundation/test_bootaccept.py passes (13). Residual risk until bootaccept --run in seed-launch.yml has probed the live seeds; ledger ops/boot-accept.jsonl. BOOT-ACCEPT-1.
